smsGame.title: Interactive SMS Markup Game
smsGame.subtitle: Convert SMS text into a placeholder template step by step and save format drafts.
smsGame.pasteStep1: Paste one real SMS line into the large field on the left.
smsGame.pasteStep2: Click "Start markup" to move to the interactive step.
smsGame.pasteStep3: After saving a format draft, you can continue the same bank series from here.
smsGame.markupWorkspace: Step 2: select fragments and replace with placeholders
smsGame.dragOutHint: Drag a chip outside the text surface to clear the slot.
smsGame.selectedTextEmpty: First select part of the text in template field.
smsGame.similarExamplePlaceholder: Add a similar SMS sample for the same format
smsGame.markupStep4: Repeat for the other important SMS parts.
smsGame.saveBlockedByEmptySlots: There are empty slots. Fill them or clear chips before saving.
smsGame.saveAndGoBank: Save format and go to bank step
smsGame.bankTitle: Step 3: enter bank name and continue the series
smsGame.bankHint: Use free-form bank name so it is clear which bank this push/SMS belongs to.
smsGame.sendersHint: Enter SMS senders (numbers, names, or short bank codes), for example: 900, ALFABANK, TINKOFF.
smsGame.issueTitle: Step 4: save results as GitHub issue
smsGame.issueTokenHint: For fine-grained token, grant Issues: Read and write and repository access.
smsGame.issueTokenEnvHint: Issue is created automatically using VITE_GITHUB_ISSUE_TOKEN from your environment.
smsGame.issueErrorNotFound: Could not create issue in {{owner}}/{{repo}}. Usually token has no repository access or Issues permission.
smsGame.issueErrorForbidden: GitHub denied request (403). Check token Issues permission (Read and write).
smsGame.issueErrorDisabled: Issues are disabled for this repository (410). Use another repository or enable Issues.
smsGame.importIssueTitle: Start work from an existing issue
smsGame.importIssueHint: Load an issue, confirm bank name, and create local format drafts for editing in workspace.
smsGame.importIssueInvalid: Enter a valid issue number or URL.
smsGame.importIssueNotFound: Issue was not found or is not accessible with this token.
smsGame.importIssueForbidden: GitHub denied issue loading (403). Check token permissions.
smsGame.importTargetHint: Bank name from issue is only a hint. Choose an existing bank or create a new one for this format.
smsGame.confirmBankAlwaysNew: A new local draft bank will be created and opened in the main workspace editor.
smsGame.confirmBankNew: No matching bank found, a local draft bank will be created.
